note: One list of which source wins when two disagree (proposal of 27 Oct 2026, from the workflow page 'Which source wins'). A lower rung number wins; a lower rung may make an answer stricter, never looser. Advisory: this is NOT the Dixit priority integer. rules_registry.json says binding priorities must be checked against the Dixit base package, which is not available, so nothing in the pipeline is decided by this file yet. It is a reference for review, for tests and for the audit log (its version is logged with every answer). A doctor, the dietitian and the client still need to confirm the order, especially rung 2 above rung 3. 'universal' lists registry rules that apply on every rung and are not ranked.

rungs.name: Emergency and harmful-intent rules (doctor-signed)
rungs.controls: The fixed reply and the end of the turn
rungs.must_never: Be softened by a food rule or the model

rungs.name: What the person told us: allergies, avoids, diet, risk group
rungs.must_never: Be overridden by a recipe or a preference

rungs.name: Condition limits and food-safety rules
rungs.controls: Salt, sugar, saturated fat, potassium, phosphorus; unsafe foods
rungs.must_never: Be relaxed by a Golden Rule

rungs.name: Golden Rule Core and Dr. Ratna's Q&A
rungs.controls: The programme: two meals, 55 minutes, fruit by status
rungs.must_never: Give a medicine, dose or portion

rungs.name: Approved swaps and recipes (dietitian)
rungs.must_never: Add a food that is not on the list

rungs.name: Condition Context, Companion, Myth-Busting
rungs.must_never: Change a route or a limit

rungs.name: General model knowledge
rungs.must_never: Add a food, a number, a claim or a rule
